comparison.objective: Remove a rejected tote while restraining a gravity-fed queue, then release the queue; candidate adjusts a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load restraint and tote transfer versus small-tool insertion, torque, fine rotation and iterative impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Red tote must reach the bin while the queue moves no more than 2 cm, then grey totes advance to the stop; candidate requires two bounded axial stops.
comparison.reason: The record tests coordinated material handling under gravity, not mechanism adjustment or damping commissioning.
